history.event: Set up at Baroda by Maharaja Sayajirao Gaekwad III under the Companies Act of 1897, paid-up capital Rs 10 lakh
Nationalised (one of 14 banks); 'The Bank of Baroda Ltd.' became 'Bank of Baroda'
Dena Bank and Vijaya Bank amalgamated into Bank of Baroda (mega-merger)
